measured.replicationParity: the forensics replica of selectPrimaryPaddleTrack matches the real selector's status+winner on 5/5 cases and reproduces the waterfall exactly: S3 23/46, S4 14/46, per-case identical (rally1 9/13→0/13).

rally1RootCause.summary: S4 scoring is NOT the culprit. The selector ranked the oracle track #1 and PICKED it; sustainedOtherPlayerFlip then truncated the picked track at 734.07ms (94→12 obs), deleting all 9 gold-covered observations before S4 was scored. The waterfall counts the winner's FULL observations at S3 (9/13) but the truncated outcome.lab at S4 (0/13) — that interval is exactly the flip deletion.
rally1RootCause.winnerNature: merged chain T6 = raw tracklet T6 (300–1335ms) + raw T15 (1635–3837ms): windowCoverage 0.955, meanScore 0.374, meanWristDistance 0.049, score 0.357, contains 9/13 gold labels — it IS the target's paddle, not a background object or opponent paddle.
rally1RootCause.flipMechanism: 3 consecutive observations around 667–734ms sit closer to the PARTNER's wrist (black-shirt player behind target, see gold eventLabels owner=other) than 0.7× the target distance; truncation keeps only the 300–667ms head. All 13 gold labels lie at 800.8–3300ms → 0 hits.
rally1RootCause.deletedTailEvidence: the deleted tail (734–3837ms, 82 obs) is decisively TARGET-owned: meanTargetWristD 0.086 vs meanOtherWristD 0.239, handAffinity 0.88 — a segment-level ownership test keeps it easily.
rally1RootCause.notAReplayArtifact: CF5 (alias-suppressed identity exactly as production builds otherWrists) still fires the same flip at 734ms (gold 9→0). Production S5=5/13 differs only because production does NOT merge tracklets, so it selected raw T9 (46 obs, 5/13, no flip).
rally1RootCause.secondaryDefect: score terms are STALE after truncation: rally2's winner T12 was cut 79→10 obs yet still scored with pre-cut windowCoverage 0.986, beating oracle T15 (coverage 0.652, 1/2 gold) on windowCoverage ×1.51.

recommendation: Wave B S4 redesign in three ordered moves. (1) KEEP the current ranking objective coverage×meanScore×proximityFactor — it is measured near-optimal (CF0 0.50 vs single-track oracle 0.52 across all 46 labels; every alternative objective measured worse: 0.26–0.35). (2) REPLACE sustainedOtherPlayerFlip truncation-by-deletion with flip-SEGMENTATION: split the candidate at sustained-flip boundaries, recompute score terms per segment (also fixes the rally2 stale-coverage defect), apply the segment-level ownership test (rally1's deleted tail: target 0.086 vs other 0.239 — trivially kept), and select the best segment. Expected S4 recall 0.30 → ~0.50 (measured CF0; +9 hits on rally1 alone) with no change to the ranking objective and precision protected by segment-level ownership. (3) THEN raise the ceiling with top-2 union / fragment merge (measured CF0 top-2 0.70; oracle merge 0.96) — but gate it behind the event-decoupling work, since production merge was previously reverted for downstream contact regressions (EXP-2026-08-28-tracklet-merge.json).
risks: Gold labels for wm-dink-01/wm-volley-02 were revised mid-session by a parallel workstream (41→46 visible); numbers were re-measured on the final snapshot and the diagnosis is snapshot-stable, but any workstream citing the old 41-label totals will disagree numerically.

Held-out cases (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1) were EVALUATED for the counterfactual table (diagnosis, not tuning); the CF ordering on held-out matches dev (CF0 dominant), so the recommendation is not dev-overfit — but the flip-segmentation change itself must be validated once on held-out after implementation.

Flip-segmentation must be checked against wrong-player PRECISION (otherPaddleFrames labels exist in the annotations for direct measurement) — the current 3-frame 0.7× flip rule fires on transient partner proximity in doubles, and its replacement must not reintroduce other-player paddles.

The waterfall replay differs from production in two ways (always-merge, no alias suppression); S4-vs-S5 comparisons across those rows conflate configurations. Suggest the waterfall owner aligns the replay or labels the rows (observation only — file is read-only for this workstream).

Other workstreams were actively editing packages/swing-lab during this session (sessionEngine.ts appeared and was fixed mid-run); repo-root typecheck was green at completion but should be re-verified at merge time.
